confidence_method: one-sided Clopper-Pearson beta lower with Bonferroni over six candidate-family claims
seed_protocol: SeedSequence spawn 6 independent streams in candidate-major/family-minor order
on_fail: retain failed result; do not change seeds, append labels, widen candidates or re-use validation to certify changed model
sample_design: n4096 gives approximately .981 design power for p=.964297 under fixed6claims; no guarantee of pass
unknown_initial: never count as future hit or no_hit; failures remain denominator and block certification

delays.identity: hypothetical relative local shear origin; action0 isolates publication,5/15/30 sensitivity only; not observed response times
